opening.argument: The presentation stays within a practical tutorial and demonstration of Google Assistant Tamil support on a mobile phone. It identifies ordinary uses, including asking the time, getting directions, playing a movie, and making calls: "there are many more things that we can ask Google like what is the time, in which direction to go, to play the movie, to call, there are many things like this". It then explains how to access or update the Google app, followed by clear language-setting steps: "click on Assistant then click on language then click on US English then click on Tamil India". The supplied screen likewise shows an "Add a language" list. The engagement request remains ordinary like, share, and subscribe activity, with no promised benefit, transaction, or data request attached.
